name: examples
description: Examples for libraries in packages @pbkware/fielded-text-web and @pbkware/fielded-text-node

scripts.all: npm run basic && npm run events && npm run sequences && npm run output && npm run node
scripts.basic: npm run basic-read-build-meta && npm run basic-read-load-meta && npm run basic-write && npm run count-records
scripts.events: npm run read-events && npm run write-events
scripts.sequences: npm run build-meta-with-sequences && npm run read-sequence && npm run read-sequence-ordinal && npm run write-sequence && npm run write-sequence-events && npm run sequences-with-readback
scripts.output: npm run write-declared && npm run write-headings && npm run write-comments
scripts.node: npm run node-basic-write && npm run node-write-declared
